propositions: Multiple test sites in test_concurrency_regression.py rely on unasserted side effects of _engine_run(..., 'list') to establish fixture preconditions, causing silent setup failures under CI load when the best-effort read path swallows errors.

Eight load-bearing fixture precondition sites (lines 378, 398, 460, 1236, 1325, 1333, 1476, 1580) need conversion from _expire_sync_marker + _engine_run to deterministic _sync_from_origin (checked fetch + ff-only merge).

Fifteen reconvergence-test sites (lines 225, 229, 319, 321, 343, 345, 469, 471, 507, 1085, 1117, 1242, 1339, 1505, 1507) deliberately use the production read path and must not be converted to raw git, but need explicit documentation of this intent.
The audit and refactor must prove deterministic correctness under REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off (the reproduction switch) and default environment.
